summary: Iteration 32: independent verification of the chunked-upload timeout fix (calamine parser + heartbeat + backup chunking) plus frontend red/green state changes. All 6 backend tests pass. Frontend confirmed via Playwright: happy path shows progress -> green tick (upload-success-state-sale); failing upload shows red XCircle 'Upload failed / No valid records found in file / Click to try again' (upload-error-state-sale) with NO transient green tick. All test data cleaned up; /api/stats total_transactions back to 11767.

minor.issue: Stale-heartbeat branch only catches ValueError; if heartbeat is ever stored as a non-string (datetime object, None-typed field variant), datetime.fromisoformat raises TypeError which is uncaught -> 500. Current write path always stores isoformat string so this doesn't manifest in production, but a raw datetime BSON write (e.g. future refactor) would break it. Suggest `except (ValueError, TypeError):` at server.py:1409.

action_items: OPTIONAL: broaden the exception clause at server.py:1409 to `except (ValueError, TypeError):` for defensive coding around the heartbeat parsing (see minor issue above).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix quality: parse_excel_streaming with python-calamine yields a ~5-8x real-world speedup (60K rows sale parses+inserts in ~7s including Mongo write vs 15min timeout previously); openpyxl fallback path preserved cleanly.

Heartbeat design is sound (5s writes during parse loop, 180s staleness threshold); recommend adding a metric/counter for how often the stale-heartbeat branch fires in production to detect silent OOM/restart rates.
_backup_replaced_records chunking of 5000 records/part correctly avoids the 16MB Mongo doc cap. Undo endpoint reads all parts in the right order.
server.py continues to grow (~7433 lines). Upload/session/heartbeat logic (~500 lines) is a natural candidate to extract into services/uploads.py.
